name: Sacituzumab Govitecan (Trodelvy)
cyclesNote: Cycled every 21 days continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.primaryStudy: ASCENT: Bardia A, et al. N Engl J Med 2021;384:1529-1541; TROPiCS-02: Rugo HS, et al. Lancet 2023;402:1423-1433

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-Q 2, 3, 9 of 15)

biomarkers.note: Indicated for: (1) locally advanced or metastatic TNBC after at least one prior systemic therapy (or 1L if PD-L1 CPS <10); (2) HR-positive, HER2-negative (including HER2-null and HER2-low) metastatic breast cancer after endocrine therapy, CDK4/6 inhibitor, and chemotherapy. TROP-2 directed antibody-drug conjugate with SN-38 topoisomerase-1 payload. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-Q (2, 3, and 9 of 15) (Category 1, Preferred).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (TNBC or HR-positive / HER2-negative)

premedications.name: Antiemetic & Antihistamine premedication
premedications.notes: Administer two-drug or three-drug antiemetic combination (e.g. 5-HT3 antagonist + dexamethasone) prior to each infusion. Give antipyretic (acetaminophen) and antihistamines prior to infusion to prevent infusion reactions.

supportiveCare: Neutropenia management: Severe or febrile neutropenia may occur. G-CSF support is recommended for secondary prophylaxis or if counts delay therapy.

Diarrhea management: If acute cholinergic diarrhea occurs during infusion, administer atropine 0.4 mg SC/IV. For delayed diarrhea, initiate loperamide (4 mg then 2 mg q2h) immediately at onset of loose stools.
UGT1A1*28 poor metabolizers: Patients homozygous for UGT1A1*28 allele are at higher risk of neutropenia and diarrhea; monitor closely.
monitoring: CBC with differential prior to each dose (Day 1 and Day 8 of each 21-day cycle)
Monitor for severe diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and hydration status each cycle
Monitor for infusion-related reactions during and for at least 30 minutes after infusion
clearanceChecks: Day 8: ANC ≥ 1000/mcL and platelets ≥ 75,000/mcL (hold Day 8 dose if counts lower)
resolution of diarrhea and stomatitis to grade ≤ 1

doseModificationRules.condition: severe neutropenia (grade 4 neutropenia ≥7 days, or febrile neutropenia)
doseModificationRules.text: Withhold sacituzumab govitecan until ANC ≥ 1500/mcL. For first occurrence, reduce dose by 25% (10 mg/kg -> 7.5 mg/kg); for second occurrence, reduce by another 25% (7.5 mg/kg -> 5 mg/kg). Discontinue if grade 4 neutropenia recurs at 5 mg/kg. Add G-CSF.
Withhold until resolved to grade ≤ 1. Resume with 25% dose reduction (7.5 mg/kg).

drugs.name: Sacituzumab Govitecan
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 9 of 15. Sacituzumab govitecan 10 mg/kg IV on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle.
